description:
Intetics Inc., a leading American technology company specializing in custom software application development, distributed professional teams creation, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is on the lookout for a Senior Kony Developer to join our team and provide exceptional customer support.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and enhance banking functionality using the Kony platform
  • Maintain and improve existing application components
  • Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into reliable solutions
  • Troubleshoot technical issues and ensure application stability
  • Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, business analysts, and other project stakeholders
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and solution design
  • Follow established development standards and contribute to high-quality delivery
  • 4.5+ years of professional experience as a Kony Developer
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kony application development
  • Experience developing functionality for banking or financial applications
  • Ability to work effectively within a distributed team
  • Proactive and solution-oriented approach
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher
